method: Both wire serialisations are read: the legacy application/csp-report body is wrapped in csp-report, while a Reporting API application/reports+json entry puts the same body in body with type csp-violation; a bare body is accepted too, and entries of another report type are skipped rather than misread. Each field is read under its hyphenated and camelCase names: document-uri/documentURL, blocked-uri/blockedURL, effective-directive/effectiveDirective, violated-directive/violatedDirective, original-policy/originalPolicy, status-code/statusCode, script-sample/sample, plus referrer, source-file, line-number and column-number. The effective directive names the directive that fired; when it is missing the first token of violated-directive is used, and when both are missing the report is grouped under (not stated). Disposition is enforce, report, or other when it is absent or unrecognised, and report-only breaches still count as breaches because the resource loaded. The blocked URI is reduced to a grouping origin: scheme and authority are lowercased, userinfo is dropped, a blob or filesystem URL is unwrapped to its inner http(s) origin, and inline, eval, data, about, javascript and other non-network schemes keep their keyword or scheme. Groups are keyed by effective directive plus origin and sorted by count descending, then directive, then origin. Control and bidirectional formatting characters are stripped, whitespace runs collapse, and each field is capped at 2,048 characters; input is capped at 512,000 characters and 1,000 reports. Nothing is fetched, stored or uploaded.
